tei:div.tei:p: 539)phag mo'i nang sgrub dang 'brel bar sbyin sreg gi spros med rnal 'byor rgyun khyer bya ba la/ thog mar mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs yul bskyed pa bsdus pa/ nang sgrub kyi skyabs sems lan gsum/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ lha bskyed sogs nas bzlas pa skabs dang bstun zhing*/ mchod bstod dge bsngo bya/ me mchod la/ me dkyil sogs spros bcas ltar mi dgos par/ thab tu me 'bud tsam gyis chog la/ rdzas 'dus byin brlab/ me mchod las/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ swā hāḥ me dkyil bskyed la/ hūm̐: ye shes rtsal las sogs/ baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las: nang sgrub las/ rdo rje phag mo sogs/ pūts+tsha hoḥ me mchod las rdzas 'dus la/ hūm̐ḥ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sogs/ stsol/ rtsa sngags mthar/ ma hā sarba/ khā hiḥ las bzhi gang yin sham gdags nas brgya rtsa sogs 'dod gsol bya/ grangs bsag tshe/ rtsa sngags dang*/ las gang yin 540)gyi sham bcas rdzas 'dus 'bul/ skabs su 'dod gsol gdags/ mthar bstod pa/ hūm̐: skye med yum chen sogs/sa bstod: tshogs mchod 'don na/ phye mar dang tshogs rdzas sogs bshams la/ tshogs mchod las/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung pad+ma sogs/ hrīḥ ḍā med kyang chog la/ spro na/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ pheṃ: rang snang rnam dag sogs/ phrin las mdzod: ḍā 'ur bdun bzhag hoḥ mkha' 'gro ma yi sogs/ shog: me mchod las/ bshags pa/ bdag mdun lhan du gshegs gsol/ bsngo smon bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ zhal gsungs ltar bris so//
